name: Version 0.80
body:
# New Features
- Timestamp Query (#138)
- Resource Synchronization based on `MTLFence` and intrapass barriers (#73)
- UAV Overlap of nvapi (#144)

# Improvements and known bug fixes
- _HENPRI_: fixed crash when loading a save.
- _Middle-earth: Shadow of War_: fixed infinite hangs on launch.
- _Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch_: fixed rendering over-exposure.
- _Ni no Kuni II Revenant Kingdom_: fixed crash on launch. This game may still have rendering issue with clouds in open area.
- _Outcast: A New Beginning_: fixed glitchy highlighted outline on characters.
- _Overwatch 2_: fixed missing effects on certain heroes' ability.
- _Shadow of the Tomb Raider_: fixed z-fighting on character clothes (again).
- _Tiebreak: Official game of the ATP and WTA_: fixed broken lighting.
- _Yakuza_ series: fixed a potential crash when changing the resolution from the game.
- _Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of Dana_: fixed crash on launch.
- _逆水寒 (Justice Online)_: fixed crash on entering game scene (@yuemingruoan).
- TSR in Unreal Engine no longer produces colorful flashing glitches.
- Many in-game benchmarks now report correct GPU time interval values since timestamp query reports true values.

Also there are other known issues with this version, and you can view them or report a new issue (as an end-user) at [dxmt.report](https://dxmt.report). Version v0.81 is planned for more bug fixes.

# News

We are changing the license of DXMT from MIT to LGPL. v0.80 will be the last release distributed in MIT license.

We are also planing for v1.0 release in the following months. Check out [our roadmap here](https://github.com/3Shain/dxmt/issues/151).

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/3Shain/dxmt/compare/v0.74...v0.80
